    Prefix extensions of string words #

    A right prefix extension records an arbitrary finite sequence of letters appended to a string word. It retains the canonical embedding of old word positions and the split coordinate inclusion/projection on every displayed vertex space. The first appended letter is recorded separately when its sign controls whether the old coordinates form a subrepresentation or a quotient representation.
